cornerCallouts: Here they come into Turn 1, a crucial braking zone and overtaking opportunity. Positioning is everything for the next few corners.
It's all about carrying speed through the Curva da Mata. Get it wrong and you will bleed time down the straight.
The Descida do Lago, the downhill section, demands absolute precision. Too much kerb and you're off!
Navigating the Esse do Lago is key to a good lap time. Maintaining momentum is paramount through here.
The Curva do Jangada requires a delicate touch. Too much aggression and the tires will suffer.
The Laranja Mecânica is a proper test of bravery. Drivers need to commit fully to extract the maximum from their cars.
The Curva do Pinheirinho is a tricky corner, requiring late braking and a precise turn-in point.
They're on the final corner now, the Curva da Ferradura. A good exit is crucial for a strong run down the start/finish straight.
strategyPoints: Tire wear is going to be a major factor on this 2.8 km Exterior layout. Managing those tires, especially the rears, will be crucial to a good race result.
With a relatively short pit lane, the pit window is going to be quite tight. Teams will need to be precise with their timing to avoid losing valuable time.
Fuel consumption could be a concern, especially in the early stages of the race. Drivers will need to balance pace with fuel saving to make it to the end.
An early safety car could really shake things up, allowing teams to gamble on strategy and gain track position. Keep an eye out for incidents in the early laps.
Undercut or overcut? With the short lap time, the undercut could be a powerful strategy here at Velo Città. Track position is king!
The abrasive surface here at Velo Città will punish the tires. Expect to see some drivers struggling with degradation towards the end of each stint.
With the high-speed nature of this Exterior layout, aerodynamic efficiency is key. Teams will be looking for the optimal balance between downforce and drag.
The relatively short lap length means that traffic could be a major issue, especially for the front runners trying to lap slower cars. Patience will be key.
